checks.name: before-start-attribution-and-first-provider-context
observations: Two real before_agent_start handlers returned separate message packets.
The first actual provider-context event contained the peer packet followed by the person packet; ctx.agent.kind was main.
Peer content DM820_PEER_BODY_92e19 retained agent attribution; person content DM820_PERSON_BODY_c0b37 retained user attribution.
The host JSONL persisted both packets as custom_message entries with matching full content and explicit attribution.

checks.name: awaited-preflight-notification-race-and-tool-context
observations: The real tool_call preflight ran before the registered tool executed.
The registered tool executed while an earlier asynchronous tool_execution_start observer was still pending: preflight=true, notificationCompleted=false.
The real tool_result handler preserved original failed-tool text DM820_ORIGINAL_TOOL_ERROR_c2b4 and appended DM820_INERT_PEER_BODY_3a61 in order.
The next actual provider context and persisted host toolResult both contained those exact two ordered text blocks with isError=true.
Native typebox schema construction and essential registered-tool availability worked.
